source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the drawbacks of Lamarckism (PDF 224).

blocks.text: Sciencedanon ne Lamarck ke khayalat qubool nahi kiye. Jab unhon ne yeh pesh kiye to evolution ka tareeqa samjhane ka koi saboot nahi tha, aur Lamarck par tajweez kardah tareeqe se zyada irtiqai tabdeeli ki himayat par tanqeed hui. Baad mein jab virasat ke tareeqe daryaft hue to Lamarckism in bunyadon par radd hua:

items: Hasil shuda khasiyaton ki koi genetic bunyad nahi, is liye yeh agli naslon mein virasat mein nahi ja saktin.
Aaza jandar ki khwahish ya zaroorat se nahi badalte.

blocks.title: Shuruat aur mansooba bandi
blocks.text: Kitab poochti hai ke hypothesis banayein ke Lamarck par apne zamane mein evolution ki himayat par tanqeed hui ya tajweez kardah tareeqe par. Is ka apna matan jawab deta hai: zyada tar irtiqai tabdeeli ke khayal ki himayat par.

blocks.prompt: Weightlifter ke muscles bare ho jate hain. Kya bachche yeh virasat mein payenge? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Bare muscles hasil shuda khasiyat hain jin se jinsi cells ke genes nahi badalte, is liye virasat mein nahi jate; yahi Lamarckism par bara aitraaz hai.

items: Hasil shuda khasiyaton ki genetic bunyad nahi, virasat mein nahi jatin.
Aaza jandar ki khwahish ya zaroorat se nahi badalte.
